description_en: Enables the intelligent O&M feature for an instance
description_zh: 打开实例的智能运维功能
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch open-diagnosis --instance-id es-cn-n6w1o1x0w001c0000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --lang en --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OpenDiagnosis

parameters.help_en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence of the request. This value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request. Default value: the language configured in the browser. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French
parameters.help_zh:
支持的请求语言，默认为浏览器请求语言。可选值：

- en：英语
- zh：简体中文
- zt：繁体中文
- es：西班牙语
- fr：法语
parameters.name: lang
